stories.title: The Ebola outbreak in DR Congo is outpacing responders
stories.summary: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is now the second largest ever, and shows no sign of slowing down. To help, researchers are trying to expand experimental vaccines and treatments

stories.title: Trump looks for a breakthrough on the Strait of Hormuz but is feeling the pressure
stories.summary: President Trump is looking for a breakthrough on the Strait of Hormuz and is feeling the pressure of the ongoing war.

stories.title: What exactly is "birth tourism?"
stories.summary: President Trump signed two executive orders targeting birthright citizenship and "birth tourism." The latter is an issue that Trump has raised for years.

stories.title: The U.S. unexpectedly lost jobs in July
stories.summary: The U.S. labor market went into reverse last month, as employers cut 23,000 jobs.  Job gains for May and June were also revised downward.

stories.title: A new investigative podcast uncovers new evidence in death of young BLM protester
stories.summary: "We Keep Us Safe," a new investigative podcast series from Embedded, uncovered new evidence in the 2020 shooting death of 16-year-old Antonio Mays Jr. -- a killing that remains unsolved.

stories.title: Deadheads forever: The long legacy of the Grateful Dead's fan community
stories.summary: As part of NPR Music's series The Ripple Effect, Isabella Gomez Sarmiento speaks with Deadheads young and old, including famous followers like reality TV host Andy Cohen, who saw his first Grateful Dead show as a teenager in 1986, and young fans just discovering the band -- and passing on their appreciation to others.
